title: 教職実践演習(中学校及び高等学校)
subtitle: Seminar on Educational Practice
courseType:

keywords: Secondary School 2.Enthusiasm of Teacher 3.Responsibility of Teacher 4.Reflection 5.Quality of Teacher
educationalGoal: In this class, first, we receive exercises and guidance from in-service teachers, and integrate "professional knowledge" such as teaching vocational education, general education, and specialized education with "professional practical skills" obtained through subject guidance and class management.
advice: This course covers items as below. 1. Teacher's role and duty 2. Subject guidance 3. Subject guidance and career guidance 4. Homeroom management 5. Cooperation with other organizations and community 6. Reflection on learning in teacher certification program 7. Teacher to aim for 8. How to learn for becoming the target teacher image
requiredKnowledge: This course is for those who are serious about becoming a teacher.

activityGoals.body: Engage in activities in this course with enthusiasm.
Be able to suggest solutions for the issues in the current education in cooperation with others
Be able to make a plan for homeroom management with reflection on the understanding of students.
Be able to make a plan for subject guidance with knowledge and experience acquired in university
Be able to describe your own pros and cons to be a good teacher.
Engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Engage in this course with enthusiasm as a good teacher. (2) Suggest the solutions for the current issues in school in cooperation with inside and outside the school. (3) Make effective plans for subject guidance and homeroom management. (4) Clarify the image of the teacher you want to aim for, clearly indicate your current position in the process of reaching it, and specify what you need to work on in the future.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Engage in this course with enthusiasm as a university student. (2) Suggest the solutions for the current issues in school. (3) Make lans for subject guidance and homeroom management. (4) Clarify the image of the teacher you want to aim for and specify what you need to work on in the future.
